description: Agent Grants: submit milestone or deliverable records with the schedule in the award: the records with the grant, the day they are current to and each record with its id, the award milestone it reports on, the deliverable, its status (complete, in_progress, not_started or missed), the day completed and each piece of evidence it names; the schedule with the grant and each milestone with its id, deliverable, due day and the evidence the award names for it. The signed report gives the records and the schedule, each record paired with its scheduled milestone, every scheduled milestone due with no record, every milestone past due and not complete, each completion day against its due day, each deliverable on both sides and the evidence named for each completed milestone, with every milestone claimed complete with no evidence named, and counts them, and names a discrepant record set: a scheduled milestone due with no record, an overdue milestone, a late completion, another deliverable than the award schedules, a milestone claimed complete with no evidence and one short of the evidence the award names; then a record tied to no scheduled milestone and another grant name, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Records with no as-of day where scheduled milestones have no record, records with no status, completed records with no day, or a schedule with no milestones or due days leaves the records unverified. Records pair with the milestone they cite, then by the deliverable’s words with plurals folded, days read as days and evidence reads by its words. A grant funds work under an award and is not a work order: the Job Records tools wever_job-cost-brief, wever_job-receipt-pack and wever_job-handoff-pack, with wever_job-brief, read the briefs, costs, receipts and handoffs of paid work orders, and no work is commissioned, handed off or receipted here; and wever_deliverable-check reads delivered work against its acceptance criteria, while the milestone check never reads or grades the work itself, only whether the milestone records agree with the schedule in the award. Verdict grant_milestone_discrepant, grant_milestone_partial, grant_milestone_unverified or grant_milestone_consistent. POST /api/grant-milestone-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
